REMOTE_CONFIG_NOT_CONFIGURED: This server is remote. Add its SFTP details and the remote Server folder under Settings > PanelBridge to edit its configuration from here.
SERVER_STATE_UNKNOWN: Cannot verify whether the server is stopped. Try again shortly.
SERVER_RUNNING: Stop the server before editing configuration.
ROLE_LOCKOUT_LAST_MANAGER: This change would leave no user able to {{action}}
ROLE_SELF_CAPABILITY_LOSS_CONFIRM: This would remove your own ability to {{action}}
ROLE_HAS_MEMBERS: {{count}} user(s) still hold this role. Pass reassignTo to move them to another role first.
SERVER_RUNNING_LEGACY: Stop the server before deleting chunks. Running servers hold save files open and will overwrite your changes on shutdown.
DOCKER_UPDATER_NOT_CONFIGURED_LEGACY: Docker update controller is not configured
APPLY_IN_PROGRESS_LEGACY: An update apply is already in progress.
CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_LEGACY: Confirm the Docker update before recreating the all-in-one container.
SAVE_FAILED_LEGACY: The world could not be saved ({{reason}}), so the server was left running. Applying the update now would lose everything since the last save.
STOP_FAILED_LEGACY: The world was saved, but the server could not be shut down ({{reason}}). It is still running, so the update was not applied.
SERVER_RUNNING_RCON_UNAVAILABLE: Stop the Project Zomboid server before applying a Docker update. RCON is not connected, so the panel cannot safely stop it for you.
